content.title: Taking payment (cash, UPI, card) — Vegetable Seller (A1)

context.setting: Your vegetable stall. Dev's potatoes cost ₹40 and onions cost ₹20: ₹60 in total. This stall accepts cash and UPI, but not cards.
context.learnerRole: Vegetable Seller; you own and run the stall alone.
context.objective: State the total, discuss the available payment methods, and confirm change or a known payment result.
constraints: Use only the prices and payment facts given in each practice.
Do not say a UPI payment is received unless the practice says it is confirmed.
Give no financial, regulatory or payment-system advice.

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes. Cash or UPI is fine.

keyExpressions.note: Say which payment methods are available.

vocabulary.definition: Money returned when someone pays more than the total.
A written record of a payment.
A digital payment method used in India.

notes: In the model, ₹100 minus ₹60 is ₹40 change.
UPI means Unified Payments Interface. Practise payment communication, not how to use an app.

items.q: The total is ₹60. The customer gives you ₹100.
The UPI payment of ₹60 is confirmed as received. Choose your reply.
options: Your ₹60 payment is received. Thank you.

answers: Your ₹60 payment is received. Thank you.

items.q: The customer asks, 'Can I pay by card?' Your stall accepts cash and UPI only.

rolePractice.instructions: Work in pairs. State the total and payment methods. Take the customer's cash, say the change and give a receipt. Then change roles.

cards.info: The total is ₹75. You accept cash and UPI. For this practice, the customer gives you ₹100 cash. You have ₹25 change and a receipt.

cards.goal: Pay for the vegetables and get a receipt.
cards.info: Ask the total and whether cash is accepted. Give ₹100 cash. Ask for a receipt.

performanceTask.prompt: The vegetables total ₹90. Your stall accepts cash and UPI only. Your partner asks to pay by card, then gives you ₹100 cash. You have ₹10 change and a receipt. Complete the payment conversation without reading the model.

selfCheck: Did I state the correct total?
Did I name only the available methods?
Did I say the correct change?

reviewRetrieval.prompt: Later, cover the model. Ask the customer's payment method.
The total is ₹90 and the customer pays ₹100. Say the change.

answerKey.answer: Your ₹60 payment is received. Thank you.
Possible seller replies: That is ₹90, please. / Sorry, cash or UPI only. / Here is your ₹10 change. / Here is your receipt.
